{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print("Number of unique patient_id:", df['patient_id'].nunique())
print("Total number of rows:", len(df))

# Check how many patients have multiple sample_seq
patient_counts = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].count()
duplicates = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]
print("Number of patients with multiple sample_seq:", len(duplicates))
print("Sample of patients with multiple entries:", duplicates.head())"}
